links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with versus without CADe, within the same endoscopists, in routine practice
links.effect: ADR 34.4% with CADe vs 30.7% without (p = 0.042); adjusted OR 1.31 (95%CI 1.11-1.55), attenuated after adjustment for endoscopist.
links.quote: In multivariable analysis, CADe remained independently associated with higher ADR (aOR 1.31, 95%CI 1.11-1.55; p = 0.002) and A+CSSPDR (aOR 1.33, 95%CI 1.13-1.56; p = 0.001), with attenuation after adjustment for endoscopist.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical effectiveness of a computer-aided detection (CADe) tool in colonoscopy using a pragmatic within-endoscopist observational design, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
